#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cmath>
#include <algorithm>
#include <iomanip>

using namespace std;

const double EPS = 1e-8;

double fastHypot(double x, double y) {
    return sqrt(x * x + y * y);
}

struct Point {
    double x, y;
    Point() : x(0), y(0) {}
    Point(double x, double y) : x(x), y(y) {}
    bool operator==(const Point& other) const {
        return fabs(x - other.x) < EPS && fabs(y - other.y) < EPS;
    }
    double distance(const Point& other) const {
        return fastHypot(x - other.x, y - other.y);
    }
};

struct Line {
    double a, b, c;
    Line() : a(0), b(0), c(0) {}
    Line(const Point& p, double angle) {
        a = sin(angle);
        b = -cos(angle);
        c = -p.x * a - p.y * b;
    }
    Line(double a, double b, double c) {
        double h = fastHypot(a, b);
        this->a = a / h;
        this->b = b / h;
        this->c = c / h;
    }
    bool parallel(const Line& other) const {
        return fabs(a * other.b - b * other.a) < EPS;
    }
    Point intersect(const Line& other) const {
        if (parallel(other)) return Point(); // null equivalent
        double det = b * other.a - a * other.b;
        return Point((c * other.b - b * other.c) / det, (a * other.c - c * other.a) / det);
    }
    Line perpendicular(const Point& point) const {
        return Line(-b, a, b * point.x - a * point.y);
    }
    double value(const Point& point) const {
        return a * point.x + b * point.y + c;
    }
    double distance(const Point& center) const {
        return fabs(value(center));
    }
    vector<Point> intersect(const struct Circle& circle) const; // forward declaration
};

struct Circle {
    Point center;
    double radius;
    Circle() : center(), radius(0) {}
    Circle(const Point& center, double radius) : center(center), radius(radius) {}
    vector<Point> intersect(const Circle& other) const {
        double dist = center.distance(other.center);
        if (dist < EPS) return vector<Point>(); // null
        Line line(2 * (other.center.x - center.x), 2 * (other.center.y - center.y),
                  other.radius * other.radius - radius * radius + center.x * center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x +
                  center.y * center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y);
        return line.intersect(*this);
    }
};

vector<Point> Line::intersect(const Circle& circle) const {
    double dist = distance(circle.center);
    if (dist > circle.radius + EPS) return vector<Point>();
    Point inter = intersect(perpendicular(circle.center));
    if (fabs(dist - circle.radius) < EPS) return vector<Point>{inter};
    double shift = sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - dist * dist);
    return vector<Point>{Point(inter.x + shift * b, inter.y - shift * a),
                         Point(inter.x - shift * b, inter.y + shift * a)};
}

int find(vector<int>& parent, int x) {
    while (parent[x] != x) {
        parent[x] = parent[parent[x]];
        x = parent[x];
    }
    return x;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    int n;
    cin >> n;
    vector<int> x(n), y(n), r(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> x[i] >> y[i] >> r[i];
    }
    vector<Circle> circles(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        circles[i] = Circle(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]);
    }
    vector<Point> points;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            vector<Point> inter = circles[i].intersect(circles[j]);
            if (!inter.empty()) {
                for (const Point& p : inter) {
                    points.push_back(p);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    vector<bool> bad(points.size(), false);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < points.size(); ++i) {
        for (size_t j = 0; j < i; ++j) {
            if (points[i] == points[j]) {
                bad[i] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    int nVertices = 0;
    for (bool b : bad) if (!b) nVertices++;
    int nEdges = 0;
    vector<int> parent(points.size());
    for (size_t i = 0; i < parent.size(); ++i) parent[i] = i;
    vector<int> rank(points.size(), 0);
    int setCount = points.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        int current = 0;
        vector<int> onThis;
        for (size_t j = 0; j < points.size(); ++j) {
            if (!bad[j] && fabs(circles[i].center.distance(points[j]) - r[i]) < EPS) {
                current++;
                onThis.push_back(j);
            }
        }
        for (size_t j = 1; j < onThis.size(); ++j) {
            int a = find(parent, onThis[j]);
            int b = find(parent, onThis[0]);
            if (a != b) {
                if (rank[a] < rank[b]) swap(a, b);
                else if (rank[a] == rank[b]) rank[a]++;
                parent[b] = a;
                setCount--;
            }
        }
        nEdges += max(current, 1);
    }
    int nComponents = setCount;
    for (bool b : bad) if (b) nComponents--;
    cout << 1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents << endl;
    return 0;
}
